programme.title: Patirati balls / Punkura
programme.desc: What does public space mean and who else cares about what is out of the screen and four walls? The documentary is investigating the loss of common values ​​through the story of Punkura magazine, created in the middle of a pandemic in Sarajevo. He was launched by sculptor Nardina Zubanović and a journalist Adrian Pečotić, with a recognizable design of Shayle Bratić. Unlike the predecessor of Urban Bug, punkura is financed by donations. The fourth number is in preparation thanks to the support of the Austrian Cultural Forum. The film offers a view from behind the scenes and the Nardina's vision of Sarajevo. / Šta znači javni prostor i kome je još stalo do onoga što postoji van ekrana i četiri zida? Dokumentarni film istražuje gubitak zajedničkih vrijednosti kroz priču o magazinu Punkura, nastalom usred pandemije u Sarajevu. Pokrenuli su ga kiparica Nardina Zubanović i novinar Adrian Pečotić, uz prepoznatljiv dizajn Šejle Bratić. Za razliku od prethodnika Urban Buga, Punkura se finansira donacijama. Četvrti broj je u pripremi zahvaljujući podršci Austrijskog kulturnog foruma. Film nudi pogled iza kulisa i Nardininu viziju Sarajeva.

programme.title: Slightly inheritance / Blago naslijeđa
programme.desc: TV series on cultural and historical treasure, as well as the traditional values ​​of the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. What does a slight heritage really mean, how much attention do we pay to him, how much do we know about him? / TV serijal o kulturnom i historijskom blagu, kao i o tradicionalnim vrijednostima područja Bosne i Hercegovine. Priča o životu na ovim prostorima... stvaranju, ljepoti, historiji, kulturi, i graditeljstvu. Što blago naslijeđa zapravo znači, koliko mu pažnje posvećujemo, koliko znamo o njemu?

programme.title: Southern action 2 / Južnjačka akcija 2
programme.desc: In order to dedicate himself to the pregnant wife Sherri and her son, the FBI agent Malcolm Turner's field business replaced her office. Nevertheless, when the former partner and mentor was killed in the case, despite the explicit prohibition of superiors, and with the help of a plump old man, he decided to return to the field, as a nanny in Tom Fuller, a businessman he believes he is involved in the case. As soon as he meets Fuller, his wife Leah, and their three problematic children, Malcolm realizes that the nanny's job could prove much more demanding than detective. Regardless, he will do everything to reveal who is guilty of the suffering of the partner and brought the household of Fulle's. / Kako bi se mogao posvetiti trudnoj supruzi Sherri i njenom sinu, agent FBI-a Malcolm Turner terenski posao zamijenio je uredskim. Ipak, kada dozna da mu je bivši partner i mentor stradao na slučaju, Malcolm se, uprkos izričitoj zabrani nadređenih, a uz pomoć odijela punašne starice Debele mame, odluči vratiti na teren, i to kao dadilja u porodici Toma Fullera, biznismena za kojeg vjeruje da je umiješan u slučaj. Čim upozna Fullera, njegovu suprugu Leah, i njihovo troje problematične djece, Malcolm shvati da bi se posao dadilje mogao pokazati znatno zahtjevnijim od detektivskog. Neovisno o tome, on će učiniti sve ne bi li otkrio tko je kriv za stradanje partnera i pritom doveo u red kućanstvo Fullerovih.

programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E33, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E33, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

With the wealth of advice and methods that are the result of many years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate his passion for teaching into a fun and credible teaching plan and program that includes a kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "to feed himself, his family and friends are one of the most important things in life." Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule. programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E01, feature series, Portugal, 2024) Simone still fights for Justin's inheritance, manipulating and threatening everyone around her to achieve her goals, even offering alliances to former enemies. Salomao and Sal start exploring Simon's dark past, revealing the secrets that could harm her in the fight for inheritance. Regina and Valdemar Oslute that Mário, whom they considered to be dead, was actually alive and involved in suspicious plans. The tension between Lalá, Jaime and other family members are worse for accusations of fireing and manipulating, especially because of Martim's hospitalization. At the same time, Cacau tries to find out who Marquinh's father is, facing painful discoveries about his past with Marc. Sal and Tomane think Susana hides the secrets of Simon and that she may even help her on the run. The investigation is progressing, and the police begin to examine Lalá to reveal her connection with several crimes, as well as the firefighter and potential embezzlement at the company. The lives of Júli and David are further complicated when David's secret past is found out that he was a gigolo. This shakes their relationship and encourages conflicts with Tiaga and Saloma. He comes up with a dangerous plan against Saloma and Tiaga, which covers an explosion of a helicopter in which Cacau disappears. Her family desperates. Regina is entangled in her own conflicts and personal dramas and tries to protect his granddaughter Marquinh from Marc who is fighting for custody. Marco and Simone join forces to separate Tiaga and Cacau, which causes a series of conflicts. Cacau abducted, and Toni saves her. She is still confused. Regina loses Marquinha and swears on the revenge of Simone, who seeks to manipulate everyone to secure her inheritance, though he struggles with terminal cancer. Tomane discovers the truth about Lola's family, and Soraia faces the consequences of her actions. Simone decisively wants to protect her wealth and rejects her daughter Susan. Marlene wants revenge and promises to expose those who have hurt Cacau. R.: Ricardo Carr ... / Cacao - (S02, E01, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Simone se i dalje bori za Justinovo nasljedstvo, manipulirajući i prijeteći svima oko sebe kako bi postigla svoje ciljeve, čak i nudeći savezništvo bivšim neprijateljima. Salomao i Sal počnu istraživati Simoninu mračnu prošlost, otkrivajući tajne koje bi joj mogle naštetiti u borbi za nasljedstvo. Regina i Valdemar slute da je Mário, kojega su smatrali mrtvim, zapravo živ i upleten u sumnjive planove. Napetost između Lalá, Jaimea i ostalih članova obitelji pogoršavaju se zbog optužbi za podmetanje požara i manipulaciju, osobito zbog Martimove hospitalizacije. Istovremeno Cacau pokušava otkriti tko je Marquinhov otac, suočavajući se s bolnim otkrićima o svojoj prošlosti s Marcom. Sal i Tomane misle da Susana skriva tajne o Simone i da joj je možda čak pomogla u bijegu. Istraga napreduje, a policija počinje ispitivati Lalá kako bi otkrila njezinu povezanost s nekoliko zločina, kao i s podmetanjem požara i potencijalnu pronevjeru u tvrtki. Životi Júlije i Davida dodatno se zakompliciraju kad se sazna Davidova tajna prošlost da je bio žigolo. To uzdrma njihov odnos i potakne sukobe s Tiagom i Salomaom. On smisli opasan plan protiv Salomaa i Tiaga koji obuhvaća eksploziju helikoptera u kojoj nestane Cacau. Njezina obitelj očajava. Regina je zapletena u vlastitim sukobima i osobnim dramama te pokušava zaštititi unuka Marquinha od Marca koji se bori za skrbništvo. Marco i Simone udruže snage kako bi razdvojili Tiaga i Cacau, a to izaziva niz sukoba. Cacau su oteli, a Toni je spašava. Ona je i dalje zbunjena. Regina izgubi Marquinha i zaklinje se na osvetu Simone koja nastoji manipulirati svima kako bi osigurala svoje nasljedstvo, premda se bori s terminalnim rakom. Tomane otkrije istinu o Lolinoj obitelji, a Soraia se suočava s posljedicama svojih postupaka. Simone odlučno želi zaštititi svoje bogatstvo, te odbacuje kćer Susanu. programme.title: In Memoriam C. Cardinal: Misterizna Claudia / In Memoriam C. Cardinale: Misteriozna Claudia
programme.desc: Claudia, La Mysterios - (Doc. Film, France, 2018), on the occasion of the death of Claudius Cardinale HTV, shows a documentary about this great actress. Claudia Cardinale was an exception in the movie world. In a very long career, she has made almost 150 films, including some of the most important in world cinema history. She was born in Tunisia. They discovered her when she was 18, and two years later she was already famous. She collaborated with some of the most famous directors. Let's mention Luchina Visconti's masterpiece "Gepard", where he occurs side by side with Alain Delon and Burt Lancaster, and Fellini's "8½". It was Fellini who gave her a mysterious nickname. After the role in Pink Panther, she became known in the English -speaking area. In Western Sergio Leone "either once in the Wild West" she stood out with a unique style. After several successful years in Hollywood, she returned to Italian and French cinema because, as she says, she did not want to become a stereotype. Claudia Cardinale embodied women of strong character, in the predecessor of feminism, before the term became popular. But in private life, the actress was a secret. It will take her years to overcome this, with the help of producer Franco Cristaldi, who has crucially influenced the direction of her career. In this documentary we will see an overview of Claudie Cardinal's professional life, and biographer Anna Maria Mori will tell us more about her private side and a passionate relationship with director Pasquale Squitieri, which lasted for 42 years. The role in Squitieri's "Claretti" brought her a prize in 1984 for the best female role. The movie speak Laurence Schifano, Jean Sorel, Jacques Perrin, Gianni Bozzzzzzakhi, Anna Maria Mori, Massimo Cristaldi and Denise Acabo. Inserts from films such as "Gepard", "8½", "Whether in Wild West" and "Claretta" show that Claudia Cardinale has forever changed the way women are displaying on the big screen. R .: Marie-Dominique Montel ... / Claudia, La Misteriosa - (dok. film, Francuska, 2018) U povodu smrti Claudije Cardinale HTV prikazuje dokumentarni film o toj velikoj glumici. Claudia Cardinale bila je iznimka u svijetu filma. U vrlo dugoj karijeri snimila je gotovo 150 filmova, među kojima su i neki od najvažnijih u povijesti svjetske kinematografije. Rođena je u Tunisu. Otkrili su je kad je imala 18 godina, a dvije godine poslije već je bila slavna. Surađivala je s nekima od najpoznatijih redatelja. Spomenimo remek-djelo Luchina Viscontija "Gepard", gdje nastupa rame uz rame s Alainom Delonom i Burtom Lancasterom, te Fellinijev "8½". Upravo joj je Fellini nadjenuo nadimak Tajanstvena. Nakon uloge u Pink Pantheru postala je poznata i na engleskom govornom području. U vesternu Sergia Leonea "Bilo jednom na Divljem zapadu" istaknula se jedinstvenim stilom. Nakon nekoliko uspješnih godina u Hollywoodu vratila se talijanskoj i francuskoj kinematografiji jer, kako sama kaže, nije htjela postati stereotip. Claudia Cardinale utjelovila je žene snažnog karaktera, u prethodnici feminizma, prije nego što je taj izraz postao popularan. No u privatnom životu glumica je bila sputana tajnom. Trebat će joj godine da to prevlada, uz pomoć producenta Franca Cristaldija, koji je ključno utjecao na smjer njezine karijere. U ovom dokumentarcu vidjet ćemo pregled profesionalnog života Claudie Cardinale, a biografkinja Anna Maria Mori reći će nam više o njezinoj privatnoj strani i strastvenoj vezi s redateljem Pasqualeom Squitierijem, koja je trajala 42 godine. Uloga u Squitierijevoj "Claretti" donijela joj je 1984. nagradu Nastro dargento za najbolju žensku ulogu. U filmu govore Laurence Schifano, Jean Sorel, Jacques Perrin, Gianni Bozzachi, Anna Maria Mori, Massimo Cristaldi i Denise Acabo. Inserti iz filmova kao što su "Gepard", "8½", "Bilo jednom na Divljem zapadu" i "Claretta" pokazuju kako je Claudia Cardinale zauvijek promijenila način prikazivanja žena na velikom platnu. R.: Marie-Dominique Montel...

But by passing the picturesque streets, watching the old -fashioned facades, we must not forget that it all started long before. Namely, Ilok is much older. In 1453 he was gaining the status of a free royal city, confirmed in 1525 since his statute has come, the only preserved medieval legal book of a city in Slavonia and continental Croatia, and there are other monuments from which they date from the Middle Ages. R .: Mirela Sakoman ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2010) Na strmoj uzvisini iznad Dunava, na krajnjem istoku hrvatskog Srijema smjestio se Ilok, grad koji je svoju fizionomiju dobio u proteklih nekoliko stoljeća, kad nakon oslobođenja od Osmanlija ovdje nastaje gospodarsko središte i trgovište. No, prolazeći slikovitim ulicama, promatrajući starinska pročelja, ne smijemo zaboraviti da je sve počelo mnogo prije. Naime, Ilok je mnogo stariji. Godine 1453. dobiva status slobodnoga kraljevskoga grada, potvrđen 1525. otkad potječe i njegov statut, jedina sačuvana srednjovjekovna pravna knjiga nekog grada u Slavoniji i kontinentalnoj Hrvatskoj, a tu su i drugi spomenici od kojih neki datiraju iz srednjega vijeka. R.: Mirela Sakoman...

programme.title: The flame of fate / Plamen sudbine
programme.desc: Le Bazar de la Charite - (S01, E07, pov. Series, France, 2019) The action of these exciting and tense ministers on emancipation and freedom is located in Paris in the TZV era. La Belle Epoque. Paris 1897. Year, at the peak of La Belle Epoque, brave social events. Paris High Society Rush to the Annual Humanitarian Fair, which is held in magnificent wooden bowl. Suddenly a fire that is expanded throughout the building and 130 people are killed, mostly women. Fate for three women have been changed forever. The naive young aristocrat Alice de Jeansin, saved by the brave worker, reveals the bitter truth about his social status. Her maid of Rose, which should soon be printed in the adventure of life, is instead mutilated and offer her unusual deal. And for Alicein Aunt, beautiful Adrienne, the fire may be the opportunity she waited - the opportunity to disappear and start over. Р.: Alexandre Laurent Ul.: Audrey Fleurot (Adrienne de Bona (Rose Rivière), Camille Lou (Alice de Jeansin), Gilbert Melki (Marc-Antoine de Lenverpre), Josiane Balasco (Madame Huchon) ... / Le Bazar de la Charite - (S01, E07, pov. serija, Francuska, 2019) Radnja ove uzbudljive i napete miniserije o emancipaciji i slobodi smještena je u Pariz u doba tzv. la belle epoquea. Pariz 1897. godine, na vrhuncu la belle epoquea, vrvi društvenim događanjima. Pariško visoko društvo pohrli na godišnji humanitarni sajam koji se održava u veličanstvenom drvenom zdanju. Iznenada bukne požar koji se proširi po cijeloj zgradi i pritom pogine 130 ljudi, uglavnom žena. Sudbine triju žene zauvijek su promijenjene. Naivna mlada aristokratkinja Alice De Jeansin, koju spašava hrabri radnik, otkriva gorku istinu o svom društvenom statusu. Njezina sluškinja Rose, koja se uskoro trebala otisnuti u avanturu života, umjesto toga biva unakažena i nude joj neobičnu pogodbu. A za Aliceinu tetu, prekrasnu Adrienne, požar je možda prilika koju je čekala - prilika da nestane i krene ispočetka. R.: Alexandre Laurent Ul.: Audrey Fleurot (Adrienne de Lenverpre), Julie de Bona (Rose Rivière), Camille Lou (Alice de Jeansin), Gilbert Melki (Marc-Antoine de Lenverpre), Josiane Balasko (Madame Huchon)...

programme.title: Cinema for Gros / Kino za groš
programme.desc: Nickelodeon - (feature film, USA, 1976) what happened in the first days of giving birth to movies in America behind the camera was often more funny than the scenes that the audience could see in the so -called "Groš cinemas", shone in city alleys, between compacted shops. It was a time when powerful companies were trying to stifle small independent producers of short films, doing it often with violence. Escaping from a dissatisfied client, Leo Harrigan, a young Chicago lawyer, falls into the world, and comes across H. J. Cobba, an independent "filmmaker". They both fall in love with a young and lovely girlfriend who throws into the shadow even the famous movie giant ... R .: Peter Bogdanovich Ul.: Ryan Oneal (Leo Harrigan), Burt Reynolds (Buck Greenway), Tatum Oneal (Alice Forsyte), Brian Keith (H.H. Cobb), Stella Stevens ... / Nickelodeon - (igrani film, SAD, 1976) Ono što se događalo u prvim danima rađanja filmova u Americi iza kamere često je bilo smješnije od scena koje je publika mogla vidjeti u takozvanim "kinima za groš", stiješnjenim u gradskim uličicama, između zbijenih trgovina. To je bilo vrijeme kad su moćne kompanije pokušavale ugušiti male neovisne proizvođače kratkih filmova, čineći to često nasiljem. Bježeći od nezadovoljnog klijenta, u taj svijet upada Leo Harrigan, mladi odvjetnik iz Chicaga, i nailazi na H. J. Cobba, neovisnog "filmaša". Obojica se zaljubljuju u mladu i ljupku djevojku koja baca u sjenu čak i slavnu filmsku divu... R.: Peter Bogdanovich Ul.: Ryan ONeal (Leo Harrigan), Burt Reynolds (Buck Greenway), Tatum ONeal (Alice Forsyte), Brian Keith (H.H. Cobb), Stella Stevens (Marty Reeves)...

programme.title: Positively / Pozitivno
programme.desc: Positive - (R Find out how they live and what Catholics do in Banja Luka do. A member of the Society of Blood Missionaries of Christ's Theologian Ivan Bosnjak will tell us who was don Ivan Merlini and why he was declared blessed. Did you know that besides the Dalmatian slopes of the Plavac Mali variety is also grown in Varaždin County? We will also find out what this is about the parish of Križovljan. Jeste li znali da se osim na dalmatinskim obroncima sorta plavac mali uzgaja i u Varaždinskoj županiji? Doznat ćemo i u kakvoj je to vezi sa župom Križovljan. Realizator: Neven-Mihael Dianežević Urednik i voditelj: Mario Raguž...

programme.title: Bible / Biblija
programme.desc: The Bible - (religious program, Croatian) Theme of Bible and artificial intelligence is deep and multi -layered, as it connects theological teachings and contemporary technological development. God created only man in his image and opportunity of man, and entrusted to him to fill the earth and to rule it, to subordinate it to himself. Artificial intelligence is only a product of human, creative genius. It is a tool, such as fire, wheel or computer - powerful but subject to human use or abuse. Therefore, it requires demands of wise and ethically responsible use. On the limitations and potentials of artificial intelligence in the Bible - Taras Bartevski and Fr. Ante Vuckovic. Editor: Iva Lerotic ... / Biblija - (religijski program, Hrvatska) Tema Biblije i umjetne inteligencije je duboka i višeslojna, jer povezuje teološka učenja i suvremeni tehnološki razvoj. Bog je stvorio na svoju sliku i priliku samo čovjeka, te mu povjerio da napuni zemlju i da njome vlada, da ju sebi podloži. Umjetna inteligencija samo je produkt ljudskog, stvaralačkog genija. Ona je alat, poput vatre, kotača ili računala - moćan, ali podložan ljudskoj uporabi ili zloupotrebi. Stoga zahtijeva zahtjeva mudro i etički odgovorno korištenje. O ograničenjima i potencijalima umjetne inteligencije u Bibliji - Taras Barščevski i fra Ante Vučković. Urednica: Iva Lerotić...

programme.title: Misa / Misa
programme.desc: Mass - (R Ivan Herceg, pastor in Nedelišće and Dean of Strigova Dean. ------ the Nedelišće settlement of Međimurje, 3 km away from Čakovec, was first mentioned in 1226 in the gift of King Bela IV. In the 16th century, one of the first Croatian printers operated here, in which Decretum Ivan Pergosic, the oldest Kajkavian book in Croatia, was printed. The Church of the Holy Trinity in Nedelišće dates from 1460, and the boat and tower were upgraded in the 17th century. A special rarity of the Church is the oldest statue of Our Lady of Lourdes in Croatia, brought from Paris in 1883, which made piety known as the "Croatian Lourdes in Nedelišće". Renovated in 1912, the church received the stained glass windows of Josef Palka from Budapest, the altar of St. Three Kings and a picture of the Last Supper. Production Organizer: Ante Vito Valić R .: Vesna Švec Hercigonja ... / Misa - (religijski program, Hrvatska, 2025) Misu 26. nedjelje kroz godinu služit će preč. Ivan Herceg, župnik u Nedelišću i dekan Štrigovskog dekanata. ----- Međimursko naselje Nedelišće, udaljeno 3 km od Čakovca, prvi se put spominje 1226. godine u darovnici kralja Bele IV. U 16. stoljeću ovdje je djelovala jedna od prvih hrvatskih tiskara, u kojoj je tiskan Decretum Ivana Pergošića, najstarija kajkavska knjiga u Hrvatskoj. Crkva Presvetog Trojstva u Nedelišću datira iz 1460. godine, a lađa i toranj dograđeni su u 17. stoljeću. Poseban raritet crkve je najstariji kip Gospe Lurdske u Hrvatskoj, donesen iz Pariza 1883. godine, čime je nastala pobožnost poznata kao "Hrvatski Lurd u Nedelišću". Renovirana 1912., crkva je dobila vitraje Josefa Palke iz Budimpešte, oltar Sv. Tri Kralja i sliku Posljednje večere. Organizator produkcije: Ante Vito Valić R.: Vesna Švec Hercigonja...

programme.title: Balara / Balara
programme.desc: Balara - (Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) Murterin Vedranko Sikic, a family nickname Balar, is a very rare example of "Renaissance Man" for today's time - multiple artistically gifted and active, expressed in drawing, painting, singing, playing, conducting, composing, acting, directing ... And he's completely self -taught! Throughout his creativity, he is inspired by the cultural heritage of the narrowest homeland and living space, the island and the place of Murter - to the extent that for himself, now at the life of a retirement age, he says he is really sorry that he was not born a hundred years earlier! R.: Ivo Kuzmanic ... / Balara - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Murterin Vedranko Šikić, obiteljskim nadimkom Balara, za današnja je vremena već vrlo rijedak primjer "renesansnog čovjeka" - višestruko umjetnički nadaren i aktivan, izražava se crtanjem, slikanjem, pjevanjem, sviranjem, dirigiranjem, skladanjem, glumom, režijom... U svemu podjednako uspješno i kvalitetno, de facto na profesionalnoj razini, a pritom je potpuno samouk! U cijelom svojem stvaralaštvu nadahnut je kulturnom baštinom najužeg zavičaja i životnog prostora, otoka i mjesta Murtera - do te mjere da za sebe, sad već u životnoj dobi umirovljenika, kaže kako mu je zapravo žao što nije rođen sto godina ranije! R.: Ivo Kuzmanić...

programme.title: Rijeka: Sea / Rijeka: More
programme.desc: Rijeka: Sea - (Nature. Film, Croatia, 2025) There is almost no corner on a planet without plastic. She does not bypass our Adriatic either. What makes the Adriatic - we checked at the Sea Research Center in Rovinj. We travel to the Kvarner islands. On the island of Mala Srakana, there used to be about 50, and today only two people. We also introduce you to the interesting history of Voz Bay on the island of Krk. They are small, but they know everything about fishing and fish - there are more and more young people in Rijeka fishing clubs. In the section of the seas of the world, we discover the secrets of the northern Atlantic, and after the world we return to domestic waters, to Jablanac. We bring the story of the church of St. Nicholas - Jablanac keeper. Editors: Irena Hrvatin and Diana Krunaš Personalist: Vesna Budiselić ... / Rijeka: More - (prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2025) Gotovo da i nema kutka na planetu bez plastike. Ona ne zaobilazi ni naš Jadran. Što čini Jadranu - provjerili smo u Centru za istraživanje mora u Rovinju. Putujemo kvarnerskim otocima. Na otoku Male Srakane nekoć je živjelo 50-tak, a danas tek dvoje ljudi. Upoznajemo vas i sa zanimljivom poviješću uvale Voz na otoku Krku. Oni su mali, ali o ribolovu i ribama znaju sve - u riječkim ribolovnim klubovima sve je više mladih. U Rubrici morima svijeta otkrivamo tajne sjevernog Atlantika, a nakon svjetskih vraćamo se u domaće vode, i to u Jablanac. Donosimo priču o crkvici sv. Nikole - čuvarici Jablanca. Urednice: Irena Hrvatin i Dajana Kruneš Realizatorica: Vesna Budiselić...

programme.desc: Sundays at 2 - (Talk Show, Croatia) A guest on Sundays at 2 Alen Muhic from Gorazde. Born from the act of war rape, he will talk about finding a biological father, whether he forgave his mother who left him immediately after birth and how much power and determination needed to leave such trauma behind and move on. Editor: Aleksandar Stankovic ... / Nedjeljom u 2 - (talk show, Hrvatska) Gost emisije Nedjeljom u 2 je Alen Muhić iz Goražda. Rođen iz čina ratnog silovanja, govorit će o tome kako je pronašao biološkog oca, je li oprostio majci koja ga je ostavila odmah nakon rođenja te koliko je snage i odlučnosti potrebno da bi se takva trauma ostavila iza sebe i krenulo dalje. Urednik: Aleksandar Stanković...

programme.title: Canary Islands: Maintenance of Life / Kanarski otoci: Održavanje života
programme.desc: Les Canaries: des îles sous perfusion - (Nature film, France, 2024) 60 years ago, parts of the first desalinization plant arrived on the Canary Islands, and today the archipelago has more such systems per square meter and per capita than any other area in the world. Desalinized water is key to life in this volcanic area, and has encouraged the unstoppable development of certain branches of the economy, more specifically, mass tourism and intense banana cultivation for exports. But production of such fresh water has its price. For desalinization, it takes a lot of energy, which they get by burning large amounts of oil, and the waste saline concentrate destroys life in the ocean and raises acidity. The documentary for the first time is exploring that the archipelago became completely dependent on desalinized water. Seeks to analyze the disabilities of desalinization and use of such water and measure the effects of the implementation of this method. Residents and researchers have become aware of the necessity of preserving their territory, health and future and heritage they leave to future generations, so they work hard to find an alternative. They seek to save water and improve its exploitation. The experience of the Canary Islands with desalinization allows us to insight into this technology, increasingly popular in the world, and is the foundation for its study. Because the droughts are increasingly frequent and more serious, before or after we will all have to take a stand on desalinization. R .: Yoann Perie Ul.: Laurent Lederer (Self) ... / Les Canaries : Des îles sous perfusion - (prirod. film, Francuska, 2024) Prije 60 godina dijelovi prvog postrojenja za desalinizaciju stigli su na Kanarske otoke, a danas arhipelag ima više takvih sustava po metru četvornome i po stanovniku od bilo kojeg drugog područja na svijetu. Desalinizirana voda ključna je za život na tom vulkanskom području, a potaknula je i nezaustavljivi razvoj određenih grana gospodarstva, konkretnije, masovnog turizma i intenzivnog uzgoja banana za izvoz. No proizvodnja takve slatke vode ima svoju cijenu. Za desalinizaciju treba mnogo energije, koju dobivaju sagorijevanjem velikih količina nafte, a otpadni slani koncentrat uništava život u oceanu i podiže mu kiselost. Dokumentarni film prvi put istražuje kako je arhipelag postao posve ovisan o desaliniziranoj vodi. Nastoji analizirati nedostatke procesa desalinizacije i uporabe takve vode te izmjeriti posljedice provedbe te metode. Stanovnici i istraživači postali su svjesni nužnosti očuvanja svojeg teritorija, zdravlja i budućnosti te naslijeđa koje ostavljaju budućim naraštajima, pa naporno rade na pronalaženju alternativa. Nastoje štedjeti vodu i unaprijediti njezino iskorištavanje. Iskustvo Kanarskih otoka s desalinizacijom omogućuje nam detaljan uvid u tu tehnologiju, sve popularniju u svijetu, i temelj je za njezino proučavanje. Budući da su suše sve učestalije i sve ozbiljnije, prije ili poslije svi ćemo morati zauzeti stajalište o desalinizaciji. R.: Yoann Perie Ul.: Laurent Lederer (Self)...

programme.desc: A cloud in the service of the law - (S03, E02, Uz. Series, Croatia, 2025) After the hosting, you will be deserved, screenwriters Snježana and Goran Tribuson have prepared a new treat, a family humorous series - a cloud in the Law. It is a combination of family series with a slight crime plot, because Nikola (Ozren Grabarić), the head of the Oblak family, is a police sergeant. He is an idealist and honesty who believes in some human values ​​and often recognizes them where they are gone. Unlike Nikola, other members of the Oblak family are far more realistic and more prone to procedures that, although benign, are on the verge of law. Nikola's wife Strawberry (Dijana Vidusin) cannot find a job, and in order to contribute to a small home budget, she often resorts to black work. Creative, curious, somewhat self -sacrificing, devoted herself to Nicholas and children and is the complete opposite of neighbors, butcher shops (Ksenija Marinkovic). Two of their sons, Bruno (Toma Medvesek) and Ratko (Borna Fadljevic), adolescents, are a source of many problems. The younger, Ratko, intellectually superior to everyone in the house while for the elder Bruno, who is by no means finished school, could not say that. Most of the time Bruno spends in a local birtia near Suvi (Zoran Cubrilo) and Ludviga (Goran Navojec) who, although older, do not differ too much from him. Different characters and preferences of family members are a source of humorous situations and complications, and in every episode Nikola is resolved by one criminal case: a kiosk breakthrough, a car theft, a breakthrough of the Kindergarten, a small fraud ... but although in the business a more successful, more intelligent and better police officer than his partner Pozgaja (Igor Mesin) Police tasks, as well as from the head of Bože (Željko Koenigsknecht), in no way progressing in the police hierarchy ... R .: Drazen Žarković Ul.: Ozren Grabarić, Dijana Vidušin, Toma Medvešek, Borna Fadljević, Goran Navojec ... / Oblak u službi zakona - (S03, E02, zab. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Nakon uspješnice Odmori se, zaslužio si, scenaristi Snježana i Goran Tribuson pripremili su nam novu poslasticu, obiteljsku humorističnu seriju - Oblak u službi zakona. Spoj je to obiteljske serije s laganim krimi zapletom, jer Nikola (Ozren Grabarić), glava obitelji Oblak, policijski je narednik. Idealist je i poštenjačina koji vjeruje u neke ljudske vrijednosti te ih nerijetko prepoznaje i tamo gdje ih nema. Za razliku od Nikole, drugi članovi obitelji Oblak daleko su realističniji i skloniji postupcima koji su, iako benigni, na rubu zakonitosti. Nikolina žena Jagoda (Dijana Vidušin) ne može naći posao, a kako bi pridonijela ionako malom kućnom budžetu, često pribjegava radu na crno. Kreativna, znatiželjna, pomalo samozatajna, posvetila se Nikoli i djeci te je potpuna suprotnost susjedi, mesarici Greti (Ksenija Marinković). Dvojica njihovih sinova, Bruno (Toma Medvešek) i Ratko (Borna Fadljević), adolescenti, izvor su mnogih problema. Mlađi, Ratko, intelektualno je nadmoćan svima u kući dok se za starijeg Brunu, koji nikako da završi školu, to ne bi moglo reći. Većinu vremena Bruno provodi u lokalnoj birtiji kod Suvog (Zoran Čubrilo) i Ludviga (Goran Navojec) koji se, iako stariji, ne razlikuju previše od njega. Različiti karakteri i sklonosti članova obitelji Oblak izvor su humornih situacija i zapleta, a u svakoj epizodi Nikola rješava i jedan kriminalistički slučaj: provalu u kiosk, krađu automobila, provalu u kvartovski dječji vrtić, sitne prevare... No iako u poslu uspješan, inteligentniji i bolji policajac od svog partnera Požgaja (Igor Mešin) koji ima široku lepezu interesa pa se rijetko stigne posvetiti policijskim zadaćama, kao i od šefa Bože (Željko Koenigsknecht), nikako da napreduje u policijskoj hijerarhiji... R.: Dražen Žarković Ul.: Ozren Grabarić, Dijana Vidušin, Toma Medvešek, Borna Fadljević, Goran Navojec...

programme.title: Sokol's eyes / Oči sokolove
programme.desc: Falcon Eyes - (E10, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The granary of Croatia, the region in the eastern part known for its fertile fields and plains, rich culture, heritage and history. Our flight above this region is starting over the vast fields of grain not far from Valpovo during the summer harvest. We will see what the spring patrol of the Queen or Ljelje looks like from the air in the Gorjani near Djakovo. It is a custom of the patrol of the ghosts of the ghosts in which the queens are dressed in festive costumes with arranged hats or crowns with sabers in their hands. The village is also dressed and performed by ritual composed of fencing and singing. This custom was registered as a Croatian cultural heritage in 1966, and in 2009 it was entered on the UNESCO list of intangible world heritage in Europe. Slavonians also like to boast about their rich cultural heritage, so our flight will be accompanied by the Gjakova berths. From the air we will witness the luxuries of Slavonian costumes in the heart of Slavonia, the beautiful Đakovo and one of the most imposing cathedrals in this region. That Slavonia is not just a plain region will also show us Joseph, a climber who finds his peace on Papuk. Our cameras will follow him on climbing on the rocks. During February, almost every major Slavonian village is the custom of riding. It is a manifestation from the time of guarding the border on the Sava from the Turks. The drone shots will be accompanied by a carnival riding in Sikirevci, not far from Slavonski Brod. Our journey will end this region at the Jankovac Forest Park, as part of the Papuk Nature Park, where we will show incredible landscapes of this area covered with snow. Naš let iznad ove regije počinjemo nad nepreglednim poljima žita nedaleko od Valpova u tijeku ljetne žetve. Vidjet ćemo kako iz zraka izgleda i proljetni ophod kraljice ili ljelje u Gorjanima pored Đakova. Riječ je o običaju ophoda o blagdanu Duhova u kojemu su kraljice odjevene u svečane nošnje s urešenim šeširima ili krunama sa sabljama u rukama. Tako odjevene obilaze selo i izvode ritual sastavljen od mačevanja i pjevanja. Ovaj običaj je 1966. godine upisan kao hrvatska kulturna baština, a 2009. upisan je i na Unescov popis nematerijalne svjetske baštine u Europi. Slavonci se vole pohvaliti i svojim bogatim kulturnim naslijeđem pa će tako naš let pratiti i Đakovačke vezove. Iz zraka ćemo svjedočiti raskoši slavonskih nošnji u srcu Slavonije, predivnom Đakovu i jednoj od najimpozantnijih katedrala u ovoj regiji. Da Slavonija nije samo ravničarski kraj, pokazat će nam i Josip, penjač koji svoj mir pronalazi na Papuku. Naše kamere pratit će ga na penjanju na stijenama. Tijekom veljače gotovo svako veće slavonsko selo ima običaj pokladnog jahanja. Riječ je o manifestaciji iz vremena čuvanja granice na Savi od Turaka. programme.title: Permaphrost dissolving: Tempered bomb / Otapanje permafrosta: Tempirana bomba
programme.desc: Degel du pergelisol: Une bombs à retardment - (Nature. Film, France, 2021) is a permaphrost layer of frozen soil, which consists of 25 % of the land area of ​​the northern hemisphere. It was created in the last ice age, and when freezing he imprisoned a large number of elements: organic matter, gases, bacteria, viruses ... The story could stop there, but now, in the past thirty years, the global warming of the permaphrost dissolving has been accelerated seven times. In doing so, greenhouse gases that accelerate their own dissolution are released, but bacteria and viruses are also released. In the frozen soil, there could even be countless infectious foci. What are the predictions of scientists? Is it too late? Nastao je u posljednjem ledenom dobu, a pri zamrzavanju je zatočio velik broj elemenata: organske tvari, plinove, bakterije, viruse... Tu bi priča mogla stati, ali sada, u proteklih trideset godina, globalnim zatopljenjem stopa otapanja permafrosta ubrzala se sedam puta. Pritom se otpuštaju staklenički plinovi koji ubrzavaju vlastito otapanje, ali se oslobađaju i bakterije i virusi. U zaleđenu tlu bi moglo čak biti i nebrojenih zaraznih žarišta. programme.title: Forests and people / Šume i ljudi
programme.desc: Forests and people - (E04, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2002) In the prehistoric times of the Mediterranean coast, they were covered with forest, and then came the increasingly developed civilization ... where on our Adriatic coast we find a glet or macchia was dominated by the once evergreen species of oak that our people calling Crnika or Cesmina. On the island of Rab there is a Dundo Forest Reserve. In it there are croaks and other evergreen woody plants protected from cutting. In this forest, scientists seek to understand the ecology of Crika's stands and restore the herbal cover to its original state. The Dundo reserve enriches Rab, helps understand why the economy of the island is largely relied on forests, why the production of lime was once on the island, where and how and how the "powerful Greece, Roman, Venetian fleets" grew ", why contemporary sculptor in the tree is looking for a trained island fate. R .: Drazen Piškorić ... / Šume i ljudi - (E04, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2002) U pretpovijesno doba obale Sredozemlja bile su prekrivene šumom, a potom su stizale sve razvijenije civilizacije... Ondje gdje na našoj jadranskoj obali nalazimo golet ili makiju dominirala je nekada zimzelena vrsta hrasta koju naš narod naziva crnika ili česmina. Na otoku Rabu nalazi se šumski rezervat Dundo. U njemu su crnike i druge zimzelene drvenaste biljke zaštićene od sječe. U toj šumi znanstvenici nastoje shvatiti ekologiju crnikinih sastojina te vratiti biljni pokrov u njegovo izvorno stanje. Rezervat Dundo obogaćuje Rab, pomaže shvatiti zašto se gospodarstvo otoka velikim dijelom oslanja na šume, zašto je nekad na otoku cvjetala proizvodnja vapna, gdje su i kako "rasle" moćne grčke, rimske, venecijanske flote, zašto suvremeni kipar baš u drvetu traži zapretane otočke sudbine. R.: Dražen Piškorić...

programme.title: Traces of traces - when dinosaurs walked Croatian / Tragom tragova - Kad su dinosauri hodali Hrvatskom
programme.desc: Trace of traces - when dinosaurs walked Croatia - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2015), a hundred million years ago, the Croatian coast did not resemble what we see today. The sea was not Adriatic either, the land was not walked by mammals, the sky did not fly birds, and not just fish lived in the seas. At that time, you would stand on the beaches of the former Ocean Tetis, and around you would be the world ruled by reptiles. Go with us in search of the magnificent giants of Mesozoic in a popular scientific trace of traces - when dinosaurs walked Croatia! R.: Tomislav Mršić ... / Tragom tragova - Kad su dinosauri hodali Hrvatskom - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2015) Prije stotinjak milijuna godina hrvatska obala nimalo nije sličila onomu što vidimo danas. Ni more nije bilo Jadransko, zemljom nisu hodali sisavci, nebom nisu letjele ptice, a u morima nisu živjele samo ribe. U to biste vrijeme stajali na plažama nekadašnjeg oceana Tetis, a oko vas bi bio svijet kojim su vladali gmazovi. Pođite s nama u potragu za veličanstvenim divovima mezozoika u popularnoznanstvenom filmu Tragom tragova - kad su dinosauri hodali Hrvatskom! R.: Tomislav Mršić...

programme.title: Endless memory / Beskrajno sjećanje
programme.desc: La Memoria Infinita - (Doc. Film, Chile, 2023) Augusto Gongor, Veteran of Chilean journalism and a prominent chronicler of the Pinochet regime, and Paulina Urrutia, actress, activist and politician, are firmly connected by a couple who has lived in love for over 20 years. Eight years ago, he was diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, and now they both face the relentless and accelerated decay of his physical and mental abilities. A story that breaks the heart at the same time and gives hope about Paulina's caring and uncompromising dedication and to Augustus's fierce struggle to keep his identity is a strong touching testimony of their love. The film is a test of human dignity and adversity in old age and mechanisms of individual and collective memories. What - and who - do we remember from the past? Why do we forget or suppress certain memories and what are the consequences for the individual and the whole country? R .: Maite Alberdi Ul.: Augusto Gongora (Self), Paulina Urrutia (Self), Gustavo Cerati (Self), Pedro Lemebel (Self), Javier Bardem (Self) ... / La memoria infinita - (dok. film, Čile, 2023) Augusto Gongora, veteran čileanskog novinarstva i istaknuti kroničar zločina Pinochetova režima, i Paulina Urrutia, glumica, aktivistica i političarka, čvrsto su povezan par koji u ljubavi živi više od 20 godina. Njemu je prije osam godina dijagnosticirana Alzheimerova bolest, a sada se oboje zajedno suočavaju s neumoljivim i ubrzanim propadanjem njegovih fizičkih i mentalnih sposobnosti. Priča koja istodobno slama srce i daje nadu govoreći o Paulininoj brižnoj i beskompromisnoj predanosti te Augustovoj žestokoj borbi da zadrži svoj identitet snažno je dirljivo svjedočanstvo njihove ljubavi. Film je ispitivanje ljudskog dostojanstva i nedaća u starosti te mehanizama individualnog i kolektivnog sjećanja. Čega - i koga - se sjećamo iz prošlosti? Zašto zaboravljamo ili potiskujemo određena sjećanja i kakve su pritom posljedice za pojedinca, ali i za cijelu zemlju? R.: Maite Alberdi Ul.: Augusto Gongora (Self), Paulina Urrutia (Self), Gustavo Cerati (Self), Pedro Lemebel (Self), Javier Bardem (Self)...

programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Mundi Classics - (Concert Film, Croatia, 2023) The National Festival of the Varaždin Baroque Evenings is the most significant music and stage event of central Croatia, founded in 1971, and today it is one of the most modern festivals of its kind in the world. From the partner's country - Switzerland, at the opening of the 53rd VBV 2023, a great La Cetra Baroque Orchestra from Basel, which was founded in 1999 at the initiative of former Schola Cantorum Basiliensis Director Dr. Peter Reidemeister. The name La Cetra (Citra) is a borrowed title of Vivaldi's concerts for the violin op. 9, and refers to the basic repertoire of the orchestra - the Italian instrumental music of the 18th century. In 2009, when Andrea Marcon, whose ensemble owed its dynamic development, appointed conductor of La Cetre, its repertoire began to spread from the early Baroque to the 19th century. La Cetra is one of the leading orchestras in the world with international performances in the most significant concert halls, such as Concertgebouw Amsterdam, Philharmonie de Paris, Festspielhaus Baden-Baden, Konzerthaus Vienna, and also acts as an opera orchestra. At our biggest and oldest festival of Baroque music, from the Varaždin Cathedral, excellent musicians under the artistic guidance of Andrea Marcon, presented themselves with the compositions of Amand Ivancic and Antoni Vivaldi, and were joined by soloists Carlos Mena, a counterenor, Jone Martinez, Soprano and the Croatian Radio and Choir. R .: Tvrtko Grgić ... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Hrvatska, 2023) Nacionalni Festival Varaždinske barokne večeri najznačajnija je glazbeno-scenska priredba središnje Hrvatske, osnovana 1971., a danas je jedan od najeminentnijih festivala te vrste u svijetu. Iz zemlje partnera - Švicarske, na otvorenju 53. VBV 2023. godine nastupio je odličan La Cetra barokni orkestar iz Basela, koji je osnovan 1999. godine na inicijativu nekadašnjeg ravnatelja Schola Cantorum Basiliensis dr. Petera Reidemeistera. Naziv La Cetra (citra) posuđeni je naslov Vivaldijevih Koncerata za violinu op. 9, a odnosi se na temeljni repertoar orkestra - talijansku instrumentalnu glazbu 18. stoljeća. Godine 2009., kada je Andrea Marcon, kojem ansambl duguje svoj dinamički razvoj, imenovan dirigentom La Cetre, njezin se repertoar počeo širiti od ranog baroka do 19. stoljeća. La Cetra je jedan od vodećih orkestara u svijetu s međunarodnim nastupima u najznačajnijim koncertnim dvoranama, kao što su Concertgebouw Amsterdam, Philharmonie de Paris, Festspielhaus Baden-Baden, Konzerthaus Beč, a djeluje i kao operni orkestar. Na našem najvećem i najstarijem festivalu barokne glazbe, iz Varaždinske katedrale, izvrsni glazbenici pod umjetničkim vodstvom upravo Andrea Marcona, predstavili su se skladbama Amanda Ivančića te Antonija Vivaldija, a u izvedbi su im se pridružili solisti Carlos Mena, kontratenor, Jone Martinez, sopran te Zbor Hrvatske radiotelevizije. R.: Tvrtko Grgić...

programme.desc: Sea, olive and vine: salty and sweet - (e01, doc. Series, Croatia, 2002) "Everyone seems to have something to say and that it is really important, and the inexplicable urge to call us to always agree to the Mediterranean mosaic, let us come up and show his components and his contradictions by drawing a line and death." It is worth stopping in front of the scene that provide salt pans. The construction is ancient and simple, the space on the coast where the sea easily enters and remains calm, intersected by the browsing and drainage channels all this together forms the field. The drive agents are wind and the sun, the raw material is only the sea, the sea forever and inexhaustible. The most consumed is a man. Solare compares to fishermen and aspirants, and they are both, they work from one harvest to the other, they speak for themselves harvests and harvests as if they were grain and vine, and that hides the bonds of salt with bread and wine. Solars usually remain silent while they work, unlike fishermen who are constantly speaking, they are angry and arguing, and only for a curse, mostly because of time, weak catches or incompetent assistants, creates tension among crew members. Emigration from the island, the disappearance of merchant ships and fishermen is in contrast to the proclaimed Mediterranean orientation. Salt, fish, olives and vine, but also drought, rain and fires are a component of life by the sea. Their fate is not only in the blissful hands of the solo, the fisherman and the heavyweight, but we all share it together. The story of white and blue fields was shot in the southern Adriatic. The harvests are the most beautiful, though not every time and the easiest, part of their lives. R .: Dominik Zen ... / More, Maslina i Loza: Slano i slatko - (E01, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2002) "Svakom se čini da ima šta reći i da je to doista važno, a neobjašnjiv je nagon što nas zove da uvijek ponovno slažemo mediteranski mozaik, sačinimo i pokažemo njegove sastavnice i njegova protuslovlja povlačeći crtu između rađanja i smrti", pisao je ugledni P. Matvejević. Vrijedi zastati pred prizorom koji pružaju solane. Gradnja je prastara i jednostavna, prostor na obali gdje more lako ulazi i ostaje mirno, presječeno dovodnim i odvodnim kanalima sve to zajedno tvori polje. Pogonska su sredstva vjetar i sunce, sirovina je samo more, more vječno i neiscrpno. Najviše se troši čovjek. Solare uspoređuju s ribarima i težacima, a oni su jedno i drugo, rade od jedne žetve do druge, sami govore o žetvama i berbama kao da su žito i loza i u tome se možda krije veza soli s kruhom i vinom. Solari obično šute dok rade, za razliku od ribara koji stalno govore, srde se i prepiru, a tek po koja psovka, najčešće zbog vremena, slabog ulova ili nesposobnih pomoćnika, stvara napetost među članovima posade. Iseljavanje s otoka, nestanak trgovačkih brodova i ribarica u suprotnosti je s proklamiranom mediteranskom orijentacijom. Sol, riba, maslina i loza, ali i suše, kiša i požari sastavnica su života uz more. Njihova sudbina nije samo u žuljavim rukama solara, ribara i težaka, već je dijelimo svi zajedno. Priča o bijelim i modrim poljima snimljena je na južnom Jadranu. Berbe su najljepši, iako ne svaki put i najlakši, dio njihovog života. R.: Dominik Zen...

programme.title: Classics to the people / Klasici narodu
programme.desc: Classics to the people - (S02, E02, artistic magazine, Croatia, 2015) close your eyes for a moment and imagine that we are in a small town in Spain in the Mancha province there in the 16th century. Imagine walking around and transforming cheap taverns into vicious castles, windmills into evil giants, and every unsightly peasant woman in a beautiful princess. And maybe this all sounds like some of the adventures from the prom, we are actually just following the stories of the lone knight Don Quixote and his faithful shield Sancha Panze in the literary work of Miguel de Cervantes. Knights and grooms were tackled with this work in the new episode "Classics to the People". Whether in a dream or on java, for the classic it is always a moment. Look and find your knight on a white horse in this episode "Classics to the People" on HRT3. R.: Robert Knjaz ... / Klasici narodu - (S02, E02, umjetnički magazin, Hrvatska, 2015) Zatvorite oči na trenutak i zamislite da smo u Španjolskoj u malom mjestu u pokrajini Mancha tamo negdje u 16. stoljeću. Zamislite kako hodamo okolicom i jeftine krčme pretvaramo u začarane dvorce, vjetrenjače u zle divove, a svaku neuglednu seljanku u prelijepu princezu. I možda vam ovo sve zvuči kao neka dogodovština s maturalca, mi zapravo samo pratimo zgode usamljenog viteza Don Quijotea i njegovog vjernog štitonoše Sancha Panze u istoimenom književnom djelu Miguela de Cervantesa. U koštac s ovim djelom uhvatili su se Vitezovi i Konjušari u novoj epizodi "Klasika narodu". Bilo u snu ili na javi, za klasiku je uvijek trenutak pravi. Pogledajte i pronađite vašeg viteza na bijelome konju u ovoj epizodi "Klasika narodu" na HRT3. R.: Robert Knjaz...

programme.title: The old man and the genus / Starac i roda
programme.desc: The old man and the genus, the story of little and Klepetan - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2020) This is the story of little and Klepetan, the relatives that Stjepan V The hunters were missing their wing 28 years ago and thus tied it to the ground forever. Taking her to him, Stephen saved her life. Since then, the two spend their days together, mostly in anticipation of new spring and warm weather. In 2002, Malena found the love of her life on the roof of Stjepan's garage. Klepetan, as Stjepan called him, returned to her every year and raised more than 60 small genera together. But every autumn brings a sad parting - Klepetan and Rod are moving on a long way back to Africa, and the little one remains alone in the village with Stephen. Without Stephen Malena, she would certainly not survive the winter and welcome her Klepetan. And Stephen, what would Stephen be without a little one? Years go by, the seasons alternate and always arrive painful autumn, but also joyful spring. This is the story of little, Klepetan and Stephen, their true loyalty ... but also deep solitude. R.: Tomislav Jelincic ... / Starac i roda, priča o Malenoj i Klepetanu - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2020) Ovo je priča o Malenoj i Klepetanu, rodama o kojima brine Stjepan Vokić, umirovljenik i udovac iz Slavonskog Broda. Lovci su Malenoj prije 28 godina propucali krilo i tako je zauvijek vezali uz zemlju. Uzevši je k sebi, Stjepan joj je spasio život. Od tada njih dvoje svoje dane provode zajedno, većinom u iščekivanju novog proljeća i toplog vremena. Malena je 2002. godine na krovu Stjepanove garaže pronašla ljubav svog života. Klepetan, kako ga je Stjepan nazvao, vraćao joj se svake godine te su zajedno odgojili više od 60 malenih roda. No, svaka jesen donese i tužan rastanak - Klepetan i rode kreću na dalek put natrag prema Africi, a Malena ostaje sama u selu sa Stjepanom. Bez Stjepana Malena sigurno ne bi preživjela zimu i dočekala svog Klepetana. A Stjepan, što bi Stjepan bez Malene? Godine prolaze, godišnja doba se izmjenjuju i uvijek stignu bolne jeseni, ali i radosna proljeća. Ovo je priča o Malenoj, Klepetanu i Stjepanu, o njihovoj istinskoj odanosti... Ali i dubokoj samoći. R.: Tomislav Jelinčić...

programme.title: Unknown Pula / Nepoznata Pula
programme.desc: Unknown Pula - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2014) Within the city of Pula, there are a series of 33 forts and 150 different defense facilities that have been preserved to date, and have belonged to the defense system of the once main naval base of the Austro -Hungarian fleet. Due to the size, schedule and accommodation in space and exceptional artistic quality, this architecture is classified as the most significant and probably the largest fortification systems in Europe. Despite its great value, which goes beyond national borders and represents a contribution to the European cultural heritage, it is unknown to the general public. Therefore, the show "Unknown Pula" in the form of a research venture reveals and presents history, the present, values ​​and future of the Pula defense system. It speaks of the importance and specifics of individual objects and the whole system, the state of preservation, the protection measures, the maintenance problems, the valorisation of domestic and foreign experts, and the possibilities and plans for the decoration and revitalization of the Pula defense system. R .: Anđelko Hundić ... / Nepoznata Pula - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2014) Unutar rastera grada Pule nalazi se niz od 33 utvrde i 150 raznih obrambenih objekata koji su do danas sačuvani, a pripadali su obrambenom sustavu nekada glavne pomorske baze austro-ugarske flote. Zbog veličine, rasporeda i smještaja u prostoru te izuzetne umjetničke kvalitete ova arhitektura svrstana je među najznačajnije, a vjerojatno i najveće fortifikacijske sustave u Europi. Usprkos velikoj vrijednosti, koja nadilazi nacionalne granice i predstavlja doprinos europskoj kulturnoj baštini, ona je nepoznata široj javnosti. Stoga emisija "Nepoznata Pula" u obliku istraživačkog pothvata otkriva i prezentira povijest, sadašnjost, vrijednosti i budućnost pulskog obrambenog sustava. Ona govori o značaju i specifičnosti pojedinih objekata i cijelog sustava, stanju očuvanosti, provedenim mjerama zaštite, problemima održavanja, valorizaciji domaćih i stranih eksperata te mogućnostima i planovima za uređenje i revitalizaciju pulskog obrambenog sustava. R.: Anđelko Hundić...

programme.title: Listen to the stone / Slušaj kamen

Hrvatski film "Slušaj kamen" priča je o tradiciji branja kamena i rada u kamenu u Pučišćima na otoku Braču ispričana kroz život trojice protagonista koji su svaki na svoj način (obrazovanje, obrada, restauracija, trgovina) vezani uz kamen. 13-minutna verzija filma nagrađena je na festivalu u Tunisu, a zanimljivo je i da je priča o kamenu otišla u svijet - prikazat će se na javnim televizijama svih zemalja sudionica projekta. programme.desc: One work - (S08, E07, Artistic Program, Croatia, 2023) "Every performance of work begins from a decision, place, shape, media, materials, substrate format; from something I can recognize as to everything that follows," says Goran Petercol, and concludes that "everything needs already exists in the beginning." The light installation "completed to the first" belongs to those works in which Petercol emphasizes the process of the creation of the work. She treats the shade as a form, so she, along with the object and light, becomes an important constructive element ... / Jedno djelo - (S08, E07, umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2023) "Svaka izvedba rada počinje od neke odluke, mjesta, oblika, medija, materijala, formata podloge; od nečeg što mogu prepoznati kako prethodi svemu što slijedi", kaže Goran Petercol i zaključuje da "sve potrebno već postoji u započetom." programme.title: Frano Parać: Judita, Opera - HNK Zagreb / Frano Parać: Judita, opera - HNK Zagreb
programme.desc: Frano Parać: Judita, Opera - HNK Zagreb - (Croatia, 2024) In the year of Marko Marulić, in which we mark the 500th anniversary of the death of the father of Croatian literature, we bring an opera hit by Croatian composer and academician Fran Parać, a kind of rarity among contemporary Croatian opera, not only on the unprecedented reception of the audience, but also on the number of renovation. 2000. The new inservation of Juda, which we recorded on our cameras on October 5, 2024 at the Croatian National Theater, and directed by Snježana Banović and under the conductor of Ivan Josip Skender, once again represents this opera work that can stand side by side with the operas of contemporary music. Judita is the first literary EP in the Croatian language, it was written in 1501, and published on April 2, 1521, on the occasion of which this date became the day of the Croatian Book. Marulić and Paraćev Judita thematizes the story taken from the Bible book on Judita, about a beautiful widow from Betuli who decides to seduce and kill the Assyrian military leader of the Oloferna, thus saving the Jewish people. In the camp of the Assyrian army, she persuades the Oloferna to conquer Betulia, and the Oloferne, blinded by Judita's beauty and wisdom, for her to have fun. Leaving alone with a drunken Olofer, Judita kills him with his sword, taking as a proof of the Olofern head. Judita, the brightest gem of our literature, which Marulić represents as an example to the people to make it aware of what faith in God, and justice at the time of the danger of the Turks penetrates, is performed by Parac in two acts and seven paintings. The composer Parac, with the help of the former dramatization of Judite Marin Caric, and in collaboration with Tonka Maroevic, assumes the role of the Librestist, uniting the former Wagner's ideal of composer-Libretist. R .: Danko Volarić ... / Frano Parać: Judita, opera - HNK Zagreb - (Hrvatska, 2024) U godini Marka Marulića, u kojoj obilježavamo 500. obljetnicu smrti oca hrvatske književnosti, donosimo opernu uspješnicu hrvatskog skladatelja i akademika Frane Paraća, svojevrsni raritet među suvremenim hrvatskim operama, ne samo po nezapamćenoj recepciji publike, već i po broju obnova koje su uslijedile nakon praizvedbe iz 2000. Nova inscenacija Judite, koju smo našim kamerama zabilježili 5. listopada 2024. u HNK Zagreb, a u režiji Snježane Banović i pod dirigentskim vodstvom Ivana Josipa Skendera, još jednom predstavlja ovo operno djelo koje može ravnopravno stati uz bok opernim tekovinama suvremene glazbe. Judita je prvi književni ep na hrvatskom jeziku, napisana je 1501., a objavljena 22. travnja 1521. godine, povodom čega taj datum postaje i Danom hrvatske knjige. Marulićeva i Paraćeva Judita tematizira priču preuzetu iz biblijske Knjige o Juditi, o lijepoj udovici iz Betulije koja odlučuje zavesti i ubiti asirskog vojskovođu Oloferna i tako spasiti židovski narod. U taboru asirske vojske ona nagovara Oloferna da osvoji Betuliju, a Oloferne, zaslijepljen Juditinom ljepotom i mudrošću, za nju priređuje zabavu. Ostavši sama s pijanim Olofernom, Judita ga ubija njegovim mačem, uzevši kao dokaz Olofernovu glavu. Juditu, najsjajniji dragulj naše književnosti, koju Marulić predstavlja kao primjer narodu da osvijeste što može učiniti vjera u Boga, i pravdu u vrijeme opasnosti od prodora Turaka, Parać izvodi u dva čina i sedam slika. Skladatelj Parać, uz pomoć nekadašnje dramatizacije Judite Marina Carića, a u suradnji s Tonkom Maroevićem, preuzima ulogu libretista, ujedinivši time nekadašnji Wagnerov ideal skladatelja-libretista. R.: Danko Volarić...

programme.desc: Dalíland - (Biographer. Film, USA, 2022) The story of later years of an unusual and fascinating marriage between the genius of Salvador Dalís and its cruel wife Gale, when their seemingly solid relationship begins to shoot. The shop is located in New York and Spain 1973, and we look at the eyes of James, a young assistant who wants to break through in the world of art, while he helps with eccentricity and Hirovit Dalí about the preparation for a large exhibition. Р.: Mary Harron ul.: Ben Kingsley, Barbara Sukow (Gala), Christopher Briney (James), Ezra Miller (Young Dali), Avital Lvova (Young Gala) ... / Dalíland - (biograf. film, SAD, 2022) Priča o kasnijim godinama neobična i fascinantna braka između genija Salvadora Dalíja i njegove okrutne supruge Gale, kada njihova naizgled čvrsta veza počinje pucati. Radnja je smještena u New Yorku i Španjolskoj 1973., a gledamo je očima Jamesa, mladog asistenta koji se želi probiti u svijetu umjetnosti, dok pomaže ekscentričom i hirovitom Dalíju oko priprema za veliku izložbu. R.: Mary Harron Ul.: Ben Kingsley (Salvador Dali), Barbara Sukowa (Gala), Christopher Briney (James), Ezra Miller (Young Dali), Avital Lvova (Young Gala)...

programme.title: We discover Croatia / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku
programme.desc: We discover Croatia - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2025) The Croatian crew from Pula on a wooden merchant ship of Tartan was part of the Nature Preservation Program at the One Ocean World Congress in Nice. Sailing on Tartani with Latin Jidr to Monaco, we met all the characteristics of that merchant ship of the only one on the Adriatic. In Nice, we also met scientists who presented the latest research at the One Ocean World Congress to effectively protect the oceans and seas. Among them was the science doctor Leon Catipovic, who came to Nic from Tromsø as part of a scientific expedition on the Norwegian sailboat of Sratsraad Lehmkuhl. Tartana was tied to the waterfront in Nice, where our gastronomy, music, photographs, as well as the Croatian tourist offer ... / Otkrivamo Hrvatsku - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2025) Hrvatska posada iz Pule na drvenom trgovačkom brodu tipa tartana bila je dio programa o očuvanju prirode na Svjetskom kongresu One Ocean u Nici. Ploveći na tartani s latinskim jidrom do Monaka, upoznali smo sve karakteristike tog trgovačkog broda jedinog na Jadranu. U Nici smo upoznali i znanstvenike koji su na svjetskom kongresu One Ocean predstavili najnovija istraživanja kako učinkovito zaštititi oceane i mora. Među njima je bio i splitski doktor znanosti Leon Ćatipović koji je u Nicu došao iz Tromsøa kao dio znanstvene ekspedicije na norveškom jedrenjaku Sratsraad Lehmkuhl. Tartana je u Nici bila vezana na rivi gdje su francuskoj publici uz pomorsku baštinu bili predstavljeni i naša gastronomija, glazba, fotografije, ali i hrvatska turistička ponuda...

programme.title: After Earth / After Earth
programme.desc: After 1000 years of catastrophic events that forced humans to leave the Earth, the vehicle with teenager Kitai Raji (Jadin Smith) and his father (Will Smith) crashes to become trapped on Earth. As Sephr was seriously injured, Kitai begins a risky journey to send a distress signal. In a confrontation with an unknown place, sophisticated types of animals that have now governed the Earth, and aliens cannot be stopped during the collision, and here the father and son must teach how to work together if they want to return to their homeland. / بعد 1000 سنة من الأحداث الكارثية التي أجبرت البشر على مغادرة الأرض، تتحطم المركبة التي تحمل المراهق كيتاي راجي (جادين سميث) ووالده سايفر (ويل سميث) ليصبحا محاصرين على الأرض. ومع إصابة سايفر بجروح خطيرة، يشرع كيتاي في رحلة محفوفة بالمخاطر ليرسل إشارة استغاثة. وفي مواجهة مع مكان مجهول التضاريس، وأنواع متطورة من الحيوانات التي صارت الآن تحكم الأرض، ومخلوقات فضائية لا يمكن وقفها هربت في أثناء حادث التصادم، وهنا يجب على الأب والابن أن يتعلما كيفية العمل معاً إذا كانا يريدان العودة إلى وطنهما.

programme.title: Cloud Atlas / Cloud Atlas
programme.desc: Six different stories in time, place and nature, later become complex and inconsistent with each other, which are said through a naval journey note that dates back to 1849, music messages for his lover, a police work of the seventies centered around a nuclear reactor, a satirical story about a trapped publisher in the home of the elderly, a rebellious girl in Korea, and a tribe living in Hawaii after the end of the world. / ست قصص مختلفة في الوقت والمكان والطابع، تصبح فيما بعد متصلة بشكل معقد وغير محسوس مع بعضها البعض، والتي تُحكى من خلال مفكرة رحلة بحرية تعود لعام 1849، ورسائل موسيقار لعشيقه، وعمل بوليسي من السبعينات يتمحور حول مفاعل نووي، وقصة ساخرة عن ناشر محبوس في دار للمسنين، وفتاة مستنسخة ثائرة في كوريا، وقبيلة تعيش في هاواي بعد نهاية العالم.

programme.title: Timecop / Timecop
programme.desc: Officer (Max Waker), who works for the security agency that regulates travel through time, must defend his life against a politician related to his past and who is trying to control his future. / يجب على الضابط (ماكس واكر) الذي يعمل في وكالة الأمن التي تنظم السفر عبر الزمن، بأن يدافع عن حياته ضد سياسي متصل بماضيه والذي يحاول أن يتحكم في مستقبله.

programme.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel / The Grand Budapest Hotel
programme.desc: The film monitors a legend that has not and will not forget, Mr. Gustav (Ralph Fines). Mr. Gustav, Room and Guidance Service Officer at the Budapest Hotel. Gustave befriends a boy named Zero Mustafa (Tony Revolory), where he works in the lobby of the hotel and Gustav takes under his wings. Gustav Maddam de (Delda Swingon), who is 84 years old, is killed and her son Dmitry (Adrian Brody) decides to take revenge on Gustav. But it is easy until now, until it comes to an invaluable ancient artistic painting, which is the legacy of the family, a risky journey begins by everyone for the painting. / يرصد لنا الفيلم أسطورةً لم ولن تنُسي ،السيد جوستاف (رالف فاينز). السيد جوستاف مسئول خدمة الغرف والإرشاد بفندق بودابست. يصادق جوستاف صبيًا يُدعى زيرو مصطفى (طوني ريفولوري) ،حيث يعمل في بهو الفندق ويأخذه جوستاف تحت جناحيه. صديقة جوستاف مدام دي (ديلدا سوينتون) التي تبلغ 84 عامًا تُقتل ويقرر ابنها ديمتري (أدريان برودي) الانتقام من جوستاف. ولكن الأمر هين إلى الآن، حتى يتعلق الأمر بلوحة فنية أثرية لا تقدر بثمن وهي إرث العائلة، تبدأ رحلة محفوفة بالمخاطر من قبل الجميع من أجل اللوحة.

programme.title: Moonrise Kingdom / Moonrise Kingdom
programme.desc: The film takes place inside an island off the coast of New Angeland in the era of the sixties, where a twelve -year -old boy and girl falls in love with each other and secretly agreed to escape together, and this results in a massive anger on the island, her conditions are turned upside down, and the various authorities try to track them all over. / تدور أحداث الفيلم داخل جزيرة قبالة سواحل نيو أنجلاند فى حقبة الستينات، حيث يقع صبي وفتاة يبلغان من العمر اثنتى عشرة عامًا، في حب بعضهما ويتفقا سرًا على الهرب معًا، وينتج عن ذلك غضب عارم في الجزيرة، وتنقلب أحوالها رأسًا على عقب، وتحاول السلطات المختلفة تعقبهما في كافة اﻷرجاء.

programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory / Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: (Charlie) A young child, who lives a happy but poor life with his parents and grandparents who love him and support him, and dreams of finding the golden ticket that gives him the opportunity to visit the mysterious (Willia Wenka) factory for chocolate, the dream is achieved and (Charlie) finds the ticket to fight with his grandfather the exciting journey in which the winners accompany Mr. (Willie Wonka) himself. / (تشارلي) طفل صغير، يعيش حياة سعيدة ولكنها فقيرة مع والديه وجدوده الذين يحبونه ويدعمونه، ويحلم بالعثور على التذكرة الذهبية التي تمنحه فرصة زيارة مصنع (ويلي وونكا) الغامض للشوكولاتة، يتحقق الحلم ويعثر (تشارلي) على التذكرة ليخوض مع جده الرحلة المثيرة التي يرافق الفائزين خلالها السيد (ويلي وونكا) نفسه.

programme.title: Dark Shadows / Dark Shadows
programme.desc: The film revolves around the character (Barnaba), rich from one of the English villages in the eighteenth century, which seduces the witch (Angelka), and broke her heart, which makes her throw him a curse that transformed a vampire, and bury him under the ground. programme.title: الزند: ذئب العاصي / الزند: ذئب العاصي
programme.desc: يٌقتل والد عاصي أمام أعينه دفاعا عن أرضه، وعندما يشتد عوده يقرر الانتقام لوالده والثأر له، ويعود إلى قريته بعد تأديته الخدمة العسكرية، فيجد نفسه في مواجهة النورس باشا وما يملك من نفوذ وسلطة قوية. / يٌقتل والد عاصي أمام أعينه دفاعا عن أرضه، وعندما يشتد عوده يقرر الانتقام لوالده والثأر له، ويعود إلى قريته بعد تأديته الخدمة العسكرية، فيجد نفسه في مواجهة النورس باشا وما يملك من نفوذ وسلطة قوية.

programme.title: كدبة كل يوم / كدبة كل يوم
programme.desc: يعمل هشام(عمرو يوسف)فى وكالة إعلانية مع هاديه(دره ذروق)وقد دعتهما زميلتهما شيرى (عبير الحريرى) لقضاء شم النسيم بمرسى علم حيث تمتلك والدتها شريهان (شيرين رضا) منتجعا سياحيا، وسوف يتم زواجها وحبيبها سيف (كريم قاسم) فى شم النسيم، وقد كانت هاديه متزوجة من عادل (محمد ممدوح) الذى كان يحبها، وتزوجته هى لضغط أهلها عليها لضرورة زواجها، وكانت هاديه أكثر تحررا وانطلاقا من عادل، الذى سمحت طيبته للتساهل مع زوجته، والرضوخ لرغبتها فى الذهاب لمرسى علم بدلا من الذهاب للأسكندرية عند والدته، بينما كان هشام متزوجاً من عيشه (دينا الشربينى) عن حب، وكانت زوجته تسعى للرومانسية وتفرغ هشام لها والتركيز معها دون غيرها، حيث كانت تغير عليه، وتريد منه ان يغير طباعه بينما كان هشام يرى ان مجرد اختلاف الطباع بين الزوجين كفيل بنجاح الزواج، ويدعى كل منهما انه سعيد، بينما خلافهم على أتفه الأسباب يومى، وقد كانت مدام شريهان غير راضية على زواج ابنتها المتحررة والتى عاشت فى الخارج، من سيف وهو من طبقة أقل، وكذلك كان رأى زوجها السابق ووالد شيرى سامى (طارق التلمسانى)، وللمساعدة فى إفشال الزيجة دعت أزواجها السابقين، القبطان عز الدين إيبك (فاروق الفيشاوى) وهو هلاس، وعزت الفيومى(بيومى فؤاد) وهو زير نساء، وصاحب كتاب كيف تخونها وتبسطها، واقترحت على عادل وهشام مصاحبة سيف فى رحلة صيد، وانفردت هى بزوجتيهما، وقام الزوجان بتوضيح مساوئ الزواج لسيف، وأنه لن يستطيع إرضاء زوجته، وإنها ستسعى للسيطرة عليه، ولن ترضى عن اى عمل يقدم عليه، حتى العلاقة الحميمة ستكون برغبتها هى وليس رغبته، لتحولها لأداء واجب، يلام اذا اداه، ويلام اذا تقاعس عنه، ونجحت الخطة وبدأ سيف فى التراجع، خصوصا وان امه هدى (سلوى عثمان)ترى ان شيرى غير ملاءمة له، وهو الشيئ الذى جعلها تؤيد رأى عادل وهشام، ولكن شريهان إكتشفت مدى حب ابنتها شيرى لسيف، فتراجعت عن موقفها ووافقت على زواج ابنتها من سيف، بينما جلست هاديه على الشاطئ وحدها، ليجلس معها كريم (عمرو صالح) صديق سيف، ويدخن معها سيجارة حشيش، وتحت تأثير نشوة المخدر، سمعت رأى كريم فى سيقانها الجميلة، لتسرع لزوجها عادل لتستثير غيرته، وتخبره امام الجميع برأى كريم فى سيقانها وتدعى انها سمحت له بتقبيلها، وشعر عادل بالصدمة، ويثور فى وجه زوجته ليخبرها بأنانيتها ورغبتها فى الحصول على كل شيء دون تقديم شيئ، ولم يقبل اعتذارها وتراجعها وطلقها، بينما حاولت عيشه إنقاذ حياتها مع هشام وقبلت بالوضع الذى يرتضيه وهو عدم التغير وتقبل صفات كل منهما للآخر، وحمدت الله انها لم تطلق مثل هاديه، بينما شعر هشام بالحسرة عندما شاهد عادل منطلقا على الشاطئ مع عدد من الفتيات الجميلات. programme.title: كابتن هيما / كابتن هيما
programme.desc: إبراهيم عباده (تامر حسني) المعروف بكابتن هيما، خريج معهد التربية الرياضية، ويستعد لشهادة الماجستير، وحلمه أن يصبح لاعب كرة قدم، ولكن حادث سيارة مأساوي لأسرته، يقضي على الجميع، ويترك له أخته الصغري توته (ميار الغيطي)، مصابة بنزيف فى المخ، تم إمتصاص معظمه بالعلاج، وبقي جزء صغير، يحتاج عملية جراحية، تتكلف مبلغاً كبيراً. إعتني هيما بأخته توته، وكأنها إبنته، وعمل كسائق لأتوبيس مدرسة خاصة، حيث تعرف على مدرسة الرسم مريم (زينه) وكان يميل إليها، وهي لم تصده. كانت مريم تعيش مع والدها (رؤوف مصطفي)، وتعاني من ملاحقة عضو مجلس الشعب حسام (أحمد زاهر)، الذى سعي للزواج بها، بعد أن فشل فى مصاحبتها دون زواج، وعندما تقدم لخطبتها من والدها، كانت مريم قلقة منه، ولا تشعر نحوه بأي أحاسيس. كان حسام فى حقيقته رجل عصابات، يستغل وضعه السياسي فى الإستيلاء على ممتلكات الغير بالتهديد، ويشارك فى إنتاج أدوية خالية من المادة الفعالة، بإعتبار أن شركته لن تخضع لتحليل المنتجات، وكان رجله الذى ينفذ له أوامره، هو رجل العصابات زيكو، الذى إعتدي بالضرب على هيما، عندما لاحظ حسام ميل مريم إليه، وعندما إزدادت العلاقة مابين مريم وكابتن هيما، قام زيكو ورجاله بإفساد فرامل اتوبيس المدرسة الذى يقوده هيما، دون إعتبار لما سيحدث للأطفال، ولكن هيما تمكن من إنقاذ الأوتوبيس والأطفال، بالإصطدام بجبل من الرمال، وكانت النتيجة فصله من العمل بالمدرسة، ولكن صديقه ملاك (أحمد راتب) صاحب محل العطور، ساعده فى الحصول على عمل بتاكسي اجرة، ليستطيع العناية باخته توته. كان حسام على علاقة بالممثلة نانا (دنيا عبدالعزيز)، التى كان يساعدها لتكون نجوميتها، وعندما عاتبته على علاقته مع مريم، ورغبته فيها، رغم أنها تميل لغيره، لطمها، فردت له اللطمة، فدفعها لتسقط من البلكون، وتلقي مصرعها، فلجأ لمدمن المخدرات محمد شوقي (يوسف عيد)، الذى تعمل طفلته نورا (مي الغيطي) لدي الممثلة الصريعة نانا، لتخبر البوليس بأنها رأت القاتل، وتمد البوليس بأوصاف كابتن هيما، وفى نفس الوقت تعبت توته أخت هيما، ودخلت المستشفي، وإستطاع زيكو إبعاد هيما عن المستشفي، وقام رجاله بخطف توته، لتهديد هيما بالإبتعاد عن مريم. تمكن ضابط المباحث عصام (محسن منصور) من القبض على كابتن هيما، وتقديمه للنيابة، بتهمة قتل الممثلة نانا، ولكن الصفة التشريحية ونتيجة المعمل الجنائي، أثبتت براءة كابتن هيما، وأفرجت عنه النيابة، وإستصدرت موافقة من النائب العام للتصرف فى القبض على صاحب الحصانة البرلمانية حسام، وفى نفس الوقت سعي هيما لإستعادة شقيقته توته من أيدي الخاطفين، وتمكن من التغلب على حسام وإنقاذ شقيقته، وتمكن ضابط المباحث عصام من القبض على حسام، ودخلت توته المستشفي وأجرت الجراحة بنجاح، وقد دفع تكلفتها تلاميذ المدرسة، الذين كانوا يحبون كابتن هيما، والذى إستعاد علاقته بمدرسة الرسم مريم. عيد)، الذى تعمل طفلته نورا (مي الغيطي) لدي الممثلة الصريعة نانا، لتخبر البوليس بأنها رأت القاتل، وتمد البوليس بأوصاف كابتن هيما، وفى نفس الوقت تعبت توته أخت هيما، ودخلت المستشفي، وإستطاع زيكو إبعاد هيما عن المستشفي، وقام رجاله بخطف توته، لتهديد هيما بالإبتعاد عن مريم. تمكن ضابط المباحث عصام (محسن منصور) من القبض على كابتن هيما، وتقديمه للنيابة، بتهمة قتل الممثلة نانا، ولكن الصفة التشريحية ونتيجة المعمل الجنائي، أثبتت براءة كابتن هيما، وأفرجت عنه النيابة، وإستصدرت موافقة من النائب العام للتصرف فى القبض على صاحب الحصانة البرلمانية حسام، وفى نفس الوقت سعي هيما لإستعادة شقيقته توته من أيدي الخاطفين، وتمكن من التغلب على حسام وإنقاذ شقيقته، وتمكن ضابط المباحث عصام من القبض على حسام، ودخلت توته المستشفي وأجرت الجراحة بنجاح، وقد دفع تكلفتها تلاميذ المدرسة، الذين كانوا يحبون كابتن هيما، والذى إستعاد علاقته بمدرسة الرسم مريم. (كابتن هيما)
